meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: Claude 会按仓库已有的风格和语言,把改动拆成多个原子提交,用 rebase/fixup 整理历史,并能查某行是谁写的、某个改动何时加入。3 个以上文件必须拆成至少 2 个提交。
howto.when: 当你提到「commit」、「rebase」、「squash」等词,或想查某行是谁写的、某个改动何时加入时,它会接管并先分析当前仓库状态。

say.text: 把当前改动提交,按模块拆成多个原子提交
say.note: 先检测仓库提交风格,再输出提交计划

say.text: 把最近几个零散提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 先分析分支位置和上游状态

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁写的、哪次提交加的

howto.what_en: Claude splits your changes into multiple atomic commits following the repo's existing style and language, tidies history with rebase/fixup, and can trace who wrote a line or when a change was added.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "commit", "rebase", "squash" and similar words, or ask who wrote a line or when a change was added; it inspects the repo state first.

say_en.text: Commit my changes, split by module into atomic commits
say_en.note: Detects repo style, then prints a commit plan

say_en.text: Squash my recent messy commits into one
say_en.note: Checks branch and upstream state first

say_en.text: Who wrote this line, and which commit added it?
say_en.note: Uses blame and log -S to trace history
